model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across different language families for six model-metric combinations. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains eight categories arranged from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -5 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family group contains six bars corresponding to six conditions shown in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red/pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Each bar includes error bars indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all bars are relatively short, ranging from approximately 1 to 5. For IE-Germanic, values range from roughly 1 to 15, with XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 15. IE-Indic shows the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 24 and several other bars near 18–21. IE-Romance bars range from roughly 1 to 13. IE-Slavic shows values from approximately 1 to 17. IE-other has bars ranging from about 1 to 8. Isolate shows very small bars close to 0, some slightly negative, with values near -1 to 1. Semitic displays notable variation, with mBERT-L₂ at approximately 11, XLM-B₂ at approximately 15, and mBERT-R₂ appearing slightly negative. Uralic shows mostly small values near 0, except for XLM-B₂ at approximately 19 and mBERT-B₂ at approximately 15. The error bars are particularly large for Uralic and Semitic categories. The bars are not sorted by value but rather grouped by language family, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the color coding described.
